name: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare / Warzone
author: SoftwareZen
description: Rapid fire, anti-recoil, aim assist, drop shot, and auto-sprint for Call of Duty.

mods.name: Rapid Fire
mods.description: Converts semi-auto weapons to full-auto while holding fire.

mods.name: Anti-Recoil
mods.description: Automatically pulls right stick down while firing to compensate for weapon recoil.

mods.name: Aim Assist
mods.description: Micro-wobble right stick while ADS to activate rotational aim assist.

mods.name: Drop Shot
mods.description: Instantly goes prone when firing + crouch button pressed.

mods.name: Auto-Sprint
mods.description: Automatically holds sprint when moving forward.
